title: JASAP: Japanese Aggrenox Stroke Prevention vs. Aspirin Programme

sections.abstract:
Phase III study to compare the preventive effect of recurrent brain infarction and safety of Aggrenox (combination drug containing sustained-release dipyridamole 200 mg/acetylsalicylic acid 25 mg) twice daily vs. acetylsalicylic acid 81 mg once daily

Posted outcomes: Number of Patients With First Recurrent Cerebral Infarction (Fatal or Non-fatal). timeframe=Up to 124 weeks. Aggrenox Capsule=45; Acetylsalicylic Acid (ASA) 81 mg Tablet=32. p=0.097
